held_out_splits.note: upstream test sets stay unseen; dev/valid splits remain in training

evaluation.duplicate_groups: a group containing a held-out member holds out every eligible member

audio_presence_evidence: published_ingest_required_nonempty_bytes_and_full_readback; check audio_sha256 and native frame metadata again; no new full audio decode
initial_root_reason: selection-v2 rules rebuilt from base on emilia and hifitts2, plus exactly one speaker (emilia: MOSS; hifitts2: upstream speaker_count) and, for hifitts2, ASR text agreeing with the upstream normalized text; effective exclusions (incl. v2's source-timeline 105 entries) inherited from selection-v2.

2.unavailable: status != ok excludes (1003); no fallback to base text
2.language_policy: exclude unless the single mapped ASR label equals the selected source language; any mismatch flag or language-candidate attempt (even empty/failed) also excludes; labels are upstream metadata, not independent language identification

3.unavailable: status != ok excludes (1003); no fallback to base text
3.language_policy: exclude unless the single mapped ASR label equals the selected source language; any mismatch flag or language-candidate attempt (even empty/failed) also excludes

verification.comparison: both texts: NFKC, casefold, NFKD with combining marks removed, U+2018/U+2019 to apostrophe, tokens [a-z0-9']+ mapped by fold_words, apostrophes removed, tokens joined without separator; Levenshtein distance over code points
verification.limit: floor(max_edit_ratio * len(comparable reference)); pass when distance <= limit
verification.unavailable: no source_normalized variant or an empty comparable reference excludes (1009)
verification.why: upstream text is book/MLS text aligned to the audio (OCR errors, reader deviations, unspoken labels); ASR misses rare names; keep only rows where the two independent texts agree

text_filter.analysis: NFC; effective characters are Unicode categories L*/N* (str.isalnum), counted as code points
text_filter.duration_source: base num_frames / sample_rate (published actual decode); no audio statistics

repetition.word_split: str.split whitespace, each word reduced to effective characters, empty words dropped

text_filter.asr_line_breaks: exclude: line breaks in ASR text mark internal chunk joins

script.analysis: letters only (str.isalpha); han/kana/hangul one unit per character, other scripts one unit per word (same-script letter run); script from the Unicode character name

speaker_metadata.evidence: upstream HiFiTTS-2 manifest speaker_count (LibriVox single-reader segments); no MOSS run; missing or non-integer values exclude (6002)
